description: This is a PHP class definition for NodeProject, which appears to model the relationship between nodes and projects in the application's domain. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, validating, and removing node-project associations.

classes.name: NodeProject
classes.description: A model class representing the association between nodes and projects in the system, with methods to manage the relationships.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a NodeProject instance based on an ID, joining with the project table.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of NodeProject objects or a count based on provided filters, supports pagination.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current NodeProject object to the database, inserting or replacing the record.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the node_id and project_id are set before saving.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes the NodeProject association from the database.
